Author: Anomek, Noir Yamato
Name: NoirMech
Description: A modified version of AnoMech by Anomek (https://github.com/anomek/AnoMech) that adds EU LPDU strats. Spawns fake party members and bosses client-side so you can practice raid mechanics without a full party. Disable AnoMech while using NoirMech. Source: https://github.com/NoirYamato/DalamudPlugins
Punchline: AnoMech with LPDU strats. Go to an inn and start practice.
